title: Reoccurring place in my dreams
content: I’ve had this reoccurring mall in my dreams ever since I was a child. It’s always a very disturbing/upsetting ambiance. I always wake up really unsettled, although nothing is generally outright “scary”. I walk in, and the floor is all cobblestone. To my left there’s a pizza shop with a stone, authentic pizza oven. There are wrought iron chairs and tables for people to dine at. Sometimes my family members are eating there, sometimes there’s nobody there. There’s a huge fountain in the middle of the mall, but it’s almost never working. Once I get passed the fountain, there’s what looks like a house door that’s green and sometimes it has glass on the top, sometimes just a curtain. It’s the only place in the mall with a door. It’s a magic shop. I never want to go in, but I always know that’s my destination in this dream. When I get in, there’s always a man working who is, quite frankly, just really creepy. Sometimes he tries to sell me crystal balls, sometimes he puts on a puppet show, sometimes he just talks to me but he’s always there. I always try to or want to leave the shop, but I never can. Sometimes I try to call for help, to no avail. Sometimes I even get my phone out but I can never dial the numbers of my safe people or even the police. I don’t ever dream that I’m leaving the mall and there’s nothing I do consistently that leads up to these dreams. If anybody has any ideas on what it might mean, I would greatly appreciate it. I’ve had these dreams ever since I can remember.
